Commercial constellation for ADS-B and IoT/M2M.
Description

Constellation of 18 satellites for M2M / IoT, thermal imaging and aviation tracking (ADS-B). High resolution multi-spectral camera, an M2M communications payload and an ADS-B payload. Incoporating high datarate communications, will become the demonstrator of a future nanosatellites constellation. Thermal, IR & Visual imaging. Aviation Tracking & Monitoring. Remote Asset Management.
